rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a period away from work or school, including an official break.

example.english: I have a two-week vacation next month.
example.traditional: 我下個月有兩個星期假期。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jau5 loeng5 go3 sing1 kei4 gaa3 kei4

rows.note: Use this when the vacation means the trip or journey itself rather than the time off.

example.english: Our vacation this year was a trip to Taiwan.
example.traditional: 我哋今年嘅旅行去咗台灣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 ge3 leoi5 hang4 heoi3 zo2 toi4 waan1
